product.description: Stage Right™ by Monoprice™ix8B 8‑Channel Live Sound and Recording MixerVersatile live sound mixer with USB recording, effects, and Bluetooth® wireless technology audioDesigned to be versatile, yet simple and easy to use, the Stage Right™ ix8B 8‑Channel Live Sound and Recording Mixer includes all of the must‑have features that make modern live sound and recording mixers useful and worthwhile. Each of the two mono channels feature combination XLR/TRS connector for mic or line input, with individual +48V phantom power options for each channel. The stereo channel features a Bluetooth® input option, so you can stream stereo audio wirelessly, rather than adding unnecessary cable connections. The built‑in analog‑to‑digital converter (ADC) and USB connection allows you to record directly to your computer, which is a feature found only on high‑end mixers at several times the price. The Stage Right™ ix8B 8‑Channel Live Sound and Recording Mixer is simply the best, most versatile, easy to use mixer designed for all common live sound or recording applications.Bluetooth® audio streamingUSB recording functionOn‑board delay effectPhantom power option for each microphone input2‑band EQ for each channelRobust metal construction SIMPLE, YET VERSATILEThe Stage Right™ ix8B is designed for simplicity, focusing on functions most commonly used in live sound and recording applications. It includes powerful features not found on comparable mixers, such as Bluetooth® connectivity, delay effects, and USB recording. This makes it ideal for a multitude of applications, including live sound, recording, podcasting, streaming, or even as a home A/V receiver for its Bluetooth functionality. No other mixer in its price range can claim the same features as the Stage Right ix8B 8‑Channel Live Sound and Recording Mixer. BLUETOOTH CONNECTIVITYOne of the most impressive things about the Stage Right™ ix line of mixers is the fact that they are the only high‑quality live sound mixers in their price range to feature Bluetooth® audio connectivity. Rather than relying on a built‑in Bluetooth antenna like many other devices, the ix8B features an external antenna to ensure reliable, high‑fidelity audio streaming. USB RECORDINGAudio mixers are not only used for live performances, they serve as recording centerpieces. The Stage Right™ ix line of desktop mixers excel at both functions. The built‑in analog‑to‑digital converter and USB connection allows direct recording to your computer, which is a feature found only on high‑end mixers at several times the price. Whether you're recording music tracks, performing at a live event, or capturing voice for a podcast or live stream, the Stage Right ix8B 8‑Channel Live Sound and Recording Mixer allows you to focus on your creativity, rather than the equipment. EFFECTS, PHANTOM POWER, EQ, AND MOREIn addition to USB recording and Bluetooth® audio streaming, the Stage Right™ ix line of desktop mixers feature individually selectable +48V phantom power for condenser mics on each mic input. Additionally, they feature an onboard delay effect that can add depth and presence to vocals in live music applications. Finally, a simple 2‑band EQ with ±15dB adjustment range at 80Hz and 12kHz is available for each mono input.  625910 2x Mic/Mono Inputs  625912 6x Mic/Mono Inputs .gte-ctr .row{margin:0;}1 Year Replacement WarrantyMonoprice™ not only stands behind every product we sell with a 1 year replacement warranty, we offer a 30 day money back guarantee as well!
